entities.name: N-SEM deprotection
observations: Reactant contains a heteroaromatic N–CH2–O–CH2–Si(CH3)3 substituent; product contains the corresponding NH and lacks the SEM fragment.
The heteroaromatic core, amide side chains, dichlorophenyl group, nitrile, and stereocenter are retained.
The key transformation is cleavage of the heteroaromatic N–CH2(SEM) bond followed by N protonation.

entities.name: Trifluoroacetic acid
observations: Used in the matching N-SEM deprotection record; consistent with acid-promoted SEM cleavage.

entities.name: Ethylenediamine
observations: Present in the matching record; likely an additive, scavenger, neutralization, or workup reagent rather than an incorporated coupling partner.

entities.name: TFA in dichloromethane
observations: Matching record used trifluoroacetic acid and ethylenediamine in dichloromethane for 3.0 hours and reported 21% isolated yield.
The database lists dichloromethane as solvent and no additional catalyst.
